custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test, with vendor A and 4 on hand, and set it inactive.
  • Create an active part, part B, for this test, with vendor A.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then the button that starts a new return).

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  3. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  4. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425733 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  5. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425733-.
